families.artefact: a reading the probe made, not the page
families.F1: SegmentedTabs strip wider than its box
families.F2: detented sheet at a narrow rung
families.F2c: the toast body's grid column (Toaster.vue), the toast past the screen
families.F4a: Timeline end targets past the plate
families.designed-dock: dock: the run's 4 px focus-ring reserve, the run strip, the status live region, a trigger's coarse hit slop (touch-floor.css), the rail's summary layer inside the dock's padding
families.designed-strip: a wide table scrolling inside the DataTable demo's own scroller
families.designed-motion: the Alert stage mid-entrance: nothing is past it 1.5 s later (triage)
families.badge: Badge never wraps (house ruling): beyond its contract
families.designed-paint: a paint or a strip the part means (shimmer, reveal, deck strip, staff window, blob bleed, range fill, status marks, corner hit area, halo)
families.demo-stage: the demo's own stage or chassis CSS under the stress pass
families.F7: a selected Chip's flood scale (glass-chip.css:27-28) past a full-width parent; a fault where that parent scrolls
families.F5: LabeledField side by side in a narrow box: its layout collapses by viewport width, not by its box
families.menu-indicator: menu check column narrower than its icon (inside the row's padding)
families.F6: an icon Button squeezed below its icon (min-inline-size: 0)
families.F3: a long word in a part's text (Label, Button, Chip, ToggleGroup item, menu row, Select, Command, Accordion, Popover, Toast)
families.pan: a vertical scroller panned sideways by a horizontal swipe (the spill inside it is the cause)
families.page: the document wider than the viewport
families.edge-sub2: past the screen by 2 px or less
families.other: a demo stage's clip around an F3 part, with no breaker recorded under it
